parent_contract.evidence_scope: Phase-2 portable structure, deterministic output assertions, module-routing controls

measurement_authority.local_scope: repo-agent-native fixture predicates and receipts only

runnable.good_evidence: the verifier validates every committed adapter receipt (grepai, scip, tree-sitter, serena, sqlite, lancedb, worktree, forgejo, git-town) against the receipt contract and requires every lane to be present, PASS, or an explicit unexercised state
runnable.hollow_mutations: fourteen planted defects: unbound subject, dirty tree marked PASS, missing provider version, undeclared policy, secret admitted into policy, unbounded budget, an unexercised lane laundered into a completed run, PASS on nonzero exit, an absent lane claiming an evidence level, dropped source read-back, removed controls, a control set with no RED observation, undeclared residue, and a leaked secret-shaped value
runnable.expected: committed receipts pass with 8 PASS lanes and 1 ABSENT lane (git-town, pinned linux_intel_64 artifact on a darwin host, Human admission required); fourteen planted defects are refused by their exact code; an empty receipt directory is refused rather than reported clean; see evals/ADAPTER_RECEIPT_MATRIX.md for the per-lane completion report

runnable.good_evidence: the verifier ingests a normalized event bundle spanning grepai/tree-sitter/scip/serena/source-readback/lancedb/test lanes for one subject and reports PASS with zero blindspots
runnable.hollow_mutations: AST/read-back/test events are dropped (hollow closure), the subject commit is changed mid-run (EVENT_SUBJECT_MISMATCH), a provider lane sets its own admitted=true (PROVIDER_SELF_ADMISSION), and an existing event ID is replayed with changed payload bytes (EVENT_ID_DRIFT)
covers: no provider lane can set its own admission truth state (admission law)
SCIP/Serena events require Tree-sitter structural coverage for every involved path (structural coverage law)
an admitted closure requires a linked, confirmed source-readback event
event identity is stable: replaying an ID with changed canonical bytes is a mechanism error, not a silent overwrite
runnable.expected: the good event bundle reports state PASS with zero blindspots and idempotent replay; hollow closure exits 2 with SOURCE_READBACK_MISSING/AST_COVERAGE_MISSING/LINK_TARGET_MISSING; wrong-subject ingest exits 64 with EVENT_SUBJECT_MISMATCH; self-admitted provider event exits 64 with PROVIDER_SELF_ADMISSION; drifted event replay exits 70 with EVENT_ID_DRIFT
